scene: The brass pastry robot offers you a steaming, star-shaped bun.
picture: Side-scrolling flat street view on a single ground line. On the far left, a bright newspaper stand sits beneath a streetlamp. In the centre, the bakery's heavy wooden door is closed. Right of centre, the player in a teal bomber jacket faces a brass pastry robot on the right extending a star-shaped bun.
shown: A steaming star-shaped pastry held out by the robot on the right
A heavy wooden door with brass knocker standing closed in the centre
A colourful newspaper stand packed with glowing tabloids on the far left
